_meta.notes: T25 terrain interaction: shared deterministic surface field, sparse soil chunks, root tunnels and voids, displacement, collapse and growth resistance.

seed.notes: World terrain seed. The same seed produces the same base surface on server and client; only edits are streamed.

surface_amplitude_m.notes: Peak relief above the base planet surface, in metres.

surface_base_frequency.notes: Base noise frequency in cycles per metre.

surface_octaves.notes: Octaves of value noise. More octaves add finer clods.

patch_radius_m.notes: Radius of the authored detailed ground. Relief fades to zero at the rim so it meets the smooth planet without a seam.

rim_fade_fraction.notes: Fraction of the patch radius over which relief fades out at the rim.

tile_size_m.notes: L0 terrain tile edge. Renders tile holes as chunks; physics collides per tile.

tile_vertices.notes: Vertices per tile edge at L0 (17 = 1 m spacing on a 16 m tile).

lod_distances_m.notes: Outer radius of each LOD ring. Ring 0 is the near field; the last ring is the patch rim.

cell_size_m.notes: Editable soil cell size. Soil physics and tunnels run on this grid.

chunk_cells.notes: Cells per terrain chunk edge. 32 x 0.5 m = a 16 m chunk.

max_active_chunks.notes: Most chunks the server simulates or persists at once.

max_depth_m.notes: Deepest soil a root may reach. Below this is bedrock and no growth is allowed.

surface_break_depth_m.notes: A tunnel this close to the surface lowers the surface instead of leaving a buried void.

max_edit_volume_m3.notes: Largest soil volume one edit may remove.

max_edits_per_tick.notes: Server-side budget on soil edits per tick.

collapse_cadence_hz.notes: How often unsupported cavities are checked for collapse.

displacement_ring_cells.notes: Width of the displaced-soil ring around a tunnel, in cells.

growth_resistance_min.notes: Cheapest growth multiplier in loose, damp soil.

growth_resistance_max.notes: Most expensive growth multiplier in compacted, dry soil.

runoff_fraction.notes: Fraction of surface water that moves to a lower neighbouring cell per soil step.

evaporation_per_s.notes: Surface water lost per second when it is not raining.

rain_absorption_per_s.notes: Surface moisture gained per second during rain.

river_enabled.notes: Carve the shared terrain field into a river channel. The channel is part of the ground field, so server and client derive the same bed.

river_center_z_m.notes: Middle of the corridor surveyed for drainage, in metres across the play area. The route inside the corridor comes from the terrain, not from this line.

river_width_m.notes: Full width of the carved channel at its banks, in metres.

river_depth_m.notes: How far the channel bed is cut below the surrounding ground at its deepest.

river_path_cell_m.notes: Grid step of the flow-accumulation survey that routes the river. Smaller finds finer valleys and costs more to build.

river_bank_slope.notes: How steeply the shoulders rise away from the water, as metres of rise per metre out. This is what turns the carve into a valley.

river_bank_apron_m.notes: How far the shoulder cut reaches either side of the channel before the untouched hillside takes over.

river_water_depth_m.notes: Depth of the stream flowing in the channel, measured from the bed up.

river_length_m.notes: Length of the corridor surveyed for the river, in metres. The trunk of the drainage inside that corridor becomes the channel.

river_flow_speed_mps.notes: Downstream speed of the stream's ripples. Zero leaves the surface standing still.
